lines: （感谢明日逐梦大佬赠送的大神认证！
（感谢液态仙人掌族酋长的大神认证！
苍白的浪头滚滚退去，留下一只蓝白色的海星在沙滩上闪闪发亮。
齐格飞打着阳伞，独自走在净空后的海滩上，手中还捧着漫游手册，眉头紧锁。
即便不情愿，弗雷德里克传信中的叱责，他也不得不认。
他是比过去强了。
能够强压拉斐尔与一众四翼天使，把他们打得满地找牙，就连米迦勒也一时奈何不了他。
然而，就算是现在的齐格飞使尽浑身解数，也不可能只身撑起这场大战。
莫说他，五百年前的巴鲁姆克身后，也有“狮子心王”
“无名英雄”
等一众英杰鼎力相助，最终才打赢了裂谷战争。
齐格飞需要帮助，前所未有地需要。
“求援呐……”
他低叹出一口气，心头难免烦躁。
齐格飞的人脉极为广阔，上到镇世三柱、奇兰诸国元首，下至冒险者公会、魔族王庭之主，他魔勇一体的独特身份，理论上甚至足以撬动整个世界。
可那也只是理论上，实际情况是根本没那么好操作。
打个最直接的比方，他现在就可以渡过裂谷海，前往魔大陆去找路西法帮忙。
无论是出于地狱方面的利益考量，还是别的什么因素，路西法大概率都会出手援助，甚至亲自率领王庭联军助战摩恩。
无论从战力方面考量，还是从引援难易度来看，求援魔族都是最省事的选择。
但这会引发一个巨大的矛盾。
他要如何向奇兰诸国，尤其是奥菲斯帝国解释？
齐格飞甚至都不用去细想，就能猜到后面会发生什么。
可若是反过来，去找帝国求援呢？
比如那位圆桌最强骑士兰斯洛特，若是愿意赶赴罗兰特援手，能起到的作用绝不亚于路西法。
问题在于，奥菲斯未必愿意蹚摩恩这摊浑水。
何况就算他们愿意发兵支援，也会引发另一个更加麻烦的问题。
奥菲斯人来了，事情结束后他们还走吗？
这次的对手可不是尼科勒那尊邪神。
太阳神是奇兰正神，其信仰更是与摩恩深度绑定的宗教。
对付祂们，在现实层面几乎等同于对付摩恩王国本身。
换句话就是借外兵平内乱，这种事一旦开了头后面会有什么结果，尽可参考满清。
求援二字说着简单，可真施行起来却要考虑多方因素，头疼至极。
偏偏齐格飞还必须尽快想出一个可行方案，给《落阳行动ii》做好准备，也给弗老大一个交代。
【三个月后，我们在罗兰特会合，开始真正的落阳行动。
弗雷德里克这封信的最后，还有一句话：
【但齐格，如果三个月后我在罗兰特没有看到援兵，或者我判断援兵的力量不足以执行我的《落阳行动》，那——】
【我会用我自己的方式呼朋唤友。

The pale waves rolled away, leaving a blue-white starfish shining on the beach.
Siegfried held a parasol and walked alone on the cleared beach, holding the travel guide in his hand and frowning.
Even if he was reluctant, he had to admit the accusations in Frederick's letter.
He is stronger than before.
He was able to overpower Raphael and a group of four-winged angels, beating them to pieces, and even Michael couldn't do anything to him for a while.
However, even if Siegfried tried his best, he still couldn't sustain this battle by himself.
Not to mention him, behind Barumke five hundred years ago, there was also the "Lion-Hearted King"
"Unsung Heroes"
With the help of a group of heroes, the Rift Valley War was finally won.
Siegfried needs help, more than ever.
"Ask for help..."
He let out a low sigh, his heart inevitably irritated.
Siegfried's network of contacts is extremely broad, ranging from the Three Pillars of the World, the heads of the Qilan Kingdoms, to the Adventurer's Guild, and the head of the Demon Tribe's Royal Court. His unique identity of being both a devil and a brave man is theoretically enough to move the entire world.
But that's just theory, the actual situation is not that easy to operate at all.
To use the most direct analogy, he can now cross the Rift Sea and go to the Demon Continent to find Lucifer for help.
Whether it is due to Hell's interests or other factors, Lucifer will most likely come to his aid, and even personally lead the Royal Court Alliance to help fight against Morn.
Regardless of considering the combat power or the difficulty of recruiting, asking for help from the demon clan is the easiest option.
But this would cause a huge contradiction.
How would he explain it to the Qilan countries, especially the Orpheus Empire?
Siegfried could guess what would happen next without even thinking about it.
But what if we go the other way and go to the empire for help?
For example, if Lancelot, the strongest knight of the Round Table, was willing to rush to Roland for help, he would be no less useful than Lucifer.
The problem is that Orpheus may not be willing to wade into the muddy waters of Moen.
What's more, even if they are willing to send troops to support, it will cause another more troublesome problem.
The Orpheans are here, will they leave when this is over?
This time the opponent is not the evil god Nikolai.
The sun god is the true god of Qilan, and his belief is a religion deeply bound to Moen.
Dealing with them is almost equivalent to dealing with the Kingdom of Morn itself in reality.
In other words, it is to borrow foreign troops to quell the internal strife. Once this kind of thing starts, you can refer to the Manchu Qing Dynasty for the consequences.
Asking for help is easy to say, but in practice, you have to consider many factors, which is a headache.
However, Siegfried must come up with a feasible plan as soon as possible to prepare for "Operation Sunset II" and give Boss Fu an explanation.
[Three months later, we met in Roland and began the real Operation Sunset.
At the end of Frederick's letter, there is another sentence:
[But Sieg, if I don’t see reinforcements in Roland after three months, or I judge that the strength of the reinforcements is not enough to carry out my "Operation Sunset", then——]
【I will use my own way to call friends.
